source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Front Suspension, p.3-19

procedures.title: Upper control arm cross shaft and/or bushings: remove and install
steps: Removal: remove the capscrews, lock washers and collars from both ends of the cross shaft.
Screw the 3/8-24 capscrew supplied with J-5888 into one end of the shaft.
Support the arm in an arbor press on J-5888-3 with J-7052-2 in place (see figure 32 in the manual), keeping the bushing flange off the support.
Press out the bushing, turn the arm over and press out the other one; discard both.
Remove the capscrew from the shaft.
Installation: with J-7052-2 in place and the arm on J-5888-3, press in one bushing (see figure 33 in the manual).
Insert the cross shaft, turn the arm over and press in the second bushing the same way.
Check that the shaft turns by hand.
Fit the collar, lock washer and capscrew at each shaft end, but do not tighten yet.
notes: Figure 33 shows installer J-7052-5 with spacer J-7052-2 and support J-5888-3.
The final tightening is done after installation per the Upper control arm procedure (bounce front end, then torque collar bolts).
